profile.subtitleJa: 使節を送った王族の地として現れるバビロン
profile.summaryJa: バビロンの王族がヒゼキヤのもとへ使節を送ったと記されます。

facts.textJa: アッシリア軍がマナセを捕らえ、バビロンへ連行したと記されます。
ネブカドネツァルはエホヤキムを捕らえ、バビロンへ連れて行こうとしました。
神殿の器物の一部がバビロンへ運ばれ、王の神殿に置かれたと記されます。
ネブカドネツァルはエホヤキンをバビロンへ連れて行き、ゼデキヤをユダの王にしました。
神殿の器物や王家の財宝がバビロンへ運ばれたと記されます。
剣を免れた人々もバビロンへ連れて行かれたと記されます。

profile.modernLocationJa: 古代都市遺跡はユーフラテス川下流域にあります。政治体としてのバビロニア領域と都市遺跡を区別します。
profile.historicalRoleJa: メソポタミアの古代都市で、文脈により王国名としても用いられます。
profile.locationNoteJa: 古代都市遺跡と現在のバービル周辺の市街地は区別され、現在の市街地全体を古代都市域とはみなせません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
Therefore the LORD brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of the LORD’s house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of the LORD’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.
He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,
